description: Every backlink row for the workspace, newest first: the linking page (linkingUrl, linkingDomain), targetUrl, anchorText, dofollow, domainAuthority, the linking site's Domain Rating (dr, with drSource ahrefs; dataforseo marks an estimate), status and dates, plus its source (index, outreach, managed or network). A link the Link Profile hides as spam carries spamKind (ad for a link ad, auto for an auto-generated page); spamScore is a 0 to 100 spam score for the link when the weekly check has one. Filter with status; get_backlink_stats gives the totals.

status.description: Filter: discovered, verified, lost, placed, identified, contacted, replied, link_placed, rejected

name: list_backlinks
